title: Biomarker
description: A Cat-VRS CategoricalVariant. Root type `Biomarker` with one subtype per `biomarker_type` value.

Biomarker.description: Root type shared by every biomarker. Subtypes below are selected by the `biomarker_type` field; the top-level schema closes the record.

Gene fusion.description: Gene fusion: one or two partner genes joined via an AdjacencyConstraint at dereference time. Shares `Rearrangement base`'s shape.

Germline Variant.description: Germline variant in a single gene.

Rearrangement.description: Chromosomal rearrangement that is neither a gene fusion nor a translocation (see `Gene fusion`, `Translocation`). Shares `Rearrangement base`'s shape.

Rearrangement base.description: Structural shape shared by `Rearrangement`, `Translocation`, and `Gene fusion`: no allele, copy change, or function consequence, and no extensions besides `biomarker_type`. Each subtype sets its own `location` constraint.

Translocation.description: Chromosomal translocation between one or two partner genes. Shares `Rearrangement base`'s shape.

Somatic Variant.description: Somatic variant in a single gene.

Wild type.description: Absence of variants in a gene.
